parameters.name: AliasName
parameters.description: The new alias of the OTA module. The alias must be 1 to 64 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods(.), hyphens (-), and underscores (\_).

parameters.name: Desc
parameters.description: The new description of the OTA module. The description can be up to 100 characters in length.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the instance. You can view the instance **ID** on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must configure this parameter. If you do not set this parameter, the call fails.
>*   If your instance has no **Overview** page or ID, you do not need to set this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ModuleName
parameters.description: The name of the OTA module.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the OTA module belongs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot update-ota-module --alias-name '条码扫描仪2' --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --module-name barcodeScanner --desc '条码扫描仪的固件模块' --product-key a1Le6d00000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot UpdateOTAModule --region cn-hangzhou --Desc '条码扫描仪的固件模块' --IotInstanceId 'iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000' --ModuleName barcodeScanner --AliasName '条码扫描仪2' --ProductKey a1Le6d00000
